extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Maestro task configuration interface with an activity picker modal open. In the right properties panel, the Implementation section has the Action dropdown set to “Execute connector activity.” The activity picker is searching for “generate email,” and the “Generate Email” result from UiPath GenAI Activities is highlighted.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the highlighted “Generate Email” result under “UiPath GenAI Activities” in the activity picker. If not already done, ensure the Action dropdown is set to “Execute connector activity” before selecting the activity.
